record.issue_text: P3: absolutize_urls does not absolutize protocol-relative //path URLs and drops non-root base paths from prefix

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls`, links are rewritten whenever `href/src.start_with?('/')` (including protocol-relative URLs like `//cdn.example.com/x`). The code then does `href.sub(/^\/+/, '')` and prepends `prefix` (scheme+host), producing `http://<embed-host>/cdn.example.com/x`, which is incorrect for `//...` URLs. This is a real behavioral bug in the introduced logic. The part about “drops non-root base paths” is less clear, but the protocol-relative mishandling is verifiable from the diff.
